Book Title: Do Not Open This Book Again
Author: Andy Lee, Heath McKenzie
Categories (Amazon): Books > Children's Books > Early Learning > Basic Concepts
Summary: Ever felt embarrassed or self-conscious? Well so does Wizz, especially when you turn the page...    Kids will laugh their way through this hilarious sequel to Do Not Open This Book, from beloved Aussie comedian Andy Lee. DO NOT OPEN THIS BOOK... AGAIN! He's back! And, once again, this cheeky blue character does not want you to open this book or turn its pages.    What reason does he have this time?    This fun story will delight children and adults alike. Keep turning the pages and find out what happens when you reach the end all over again, if you dare!   WORLD-WIDE APPEAL:  The Do Not Open This Book series has been translated into 35 languages and sold over two million copies around the world.     ENTERTAINING & INTERACTIVE:  Kids love the way Wizz speaks directly to them in the story! Turning the page always has a consequence, what will it be this time?     HILARITY ENSUES : Kids and adults alike will delight in reading these books over and over again, despite Wizz's best efforts!
